AVIF source notices
===================

These files are unmodified license and patent notices from the pinned libavif
v1.4.2 and AOM commit `44d0a57786f432d933ff64b653347c66f4d0fa1d`
official source archives. `tools/avif-engine/Build-AvifEngine.py` verifies each
file byte-for-byte against its source archive during an isolated rebuild. The
libavif and AOM main licenses are BSD-style; AOM's PATENTS file accompanies
its license. Additional AOM `third_party` notices are retained conservatively
for dependency review. The archive URLs and SHA-256 pins are documented in
`tools/avif-engine/README.md`.
